When FTX took a loss in the hundreds of million dollars because a trader had exploited its system, Wang moved that loss onto Alameda’s balance sheet.
Bankman-Fried directed him to have Alameda take it on instead, because FTX’s balance sheets were visible to investors and Alameda’s weren’t.
No other customer trading on FTX had “allow_negative” privileges — only Alameda.
Alameda could have negative balances and unlimited withdrawals.
